personality_one_liner: An elegant, magazine-like digital dining experience that builds anticipation through curated photography and generous whitespace.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like rhythms. Avoid dense cards. Let content breathe.

dont's: No glassmorphism used in Editorial personality to maintain print/magazine feel.

screens.name: Outlet Selector & Home
screens.purpose: Anticipatory entry point showcasing locations and setting the dining expectation.

states.empty: No nearby outlets found. Elegant illustration with location search input.
states.error: Unable to fetch locations. Clean text with retry action.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero images for each outlet with a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Display title pinned to the bottom 30%. Elegant tab bar at the bottom.

screens.name: Menu Discover
screens.purpose: Browse and filter menu items with dietary and spice level preferences.

states.empty: No items match selected filters (e.g., Vegan + High Spice). Clear filters CTA.
states.error: Menu failed to load. Quiet error text and retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header for category navigation. Filter chips (pill-shaped with hairline borders) underneath. Full-width item rows featuring high-quality right-aligned imagery, elegant typography, and dietary tags.

screens.name: Item Detail
screens.purpose: Customize meal portions, spice levels, and modifiers before adding to cart.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge top hero image. Large Playfair display title. Clean radio groups with 1pt borders for options. Sticky primary CTA anchored at the bottom (safe area respected).

screens.name: Cart & Checkout
screens.purpose: Review order, select dining mode (pickup/delivery/dine-in), and view itemized charges.

states.empty: Cart is empty. Suggestive 'Explore the Menu' CTA.

screens.layout: Minimalist line items separated by quiet dividers. Distinct breakdown block for Tax, Packaging, Service, and Total. Fixed bottom container for checkout button.

screens.name: Order Tracking & Reservations
screens.purpose: Track live order status or view waitlist/reservation details.
screens.layout: Vertical stepper timeline with Feather icons for tracking. Segmented controls for toggling between Orders and Reservations. High-contrast typography for wait times.

hero_outlet.alt: Elegant fine dining restaurant interior with warm lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Use full-width images, quiet dividers, and plenty of vertical whitespace.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, heavy shadows, or rounded cards. Maintain sharp edges (radius 0) and flat surfaces.
Typography hierarchy is crucial: Use the serif display font (PlayfairDisplay-Regular) for large titles, and sans-serif (Geist-Regular) for body and UI elements.
Implement a mandatory top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to at least 70% surfaceInverse) whenever placing text over imagery (e.g., Outlet selection cards, Item detail hero).
The primary action button (e.g., 'Add to Cart', 'Checkout') must be sticky at the bottom, outside the scrolling area, respecting the safe area.
Filter chips for dietary tags and spice levels should have a subtle 1pt border and no background fill unless selected. Use the brandPrimary (Terracotta) for selected states.
Order timeline should be built using a vertical layout with quiet line dividers connecting the steps, emphasizing minimalist typography.
